test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

The smell of _______ **(formerly)** brewed coffee wafted through the air, beckoning him to start his day.
solution:
The correct answer is **"subsequently."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"formerly"** means previously or in the past. (अतीत में; अब से पहले)

 
 
• **Example**:* The European Union was **formerly**__ called the European Community.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **"formerly"** is **"subsequently."**
 
• **"Subsequently"** means afterward or later. (बाद में, तदनंतर)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The rumours were **subsequently**__ found to be untrue.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the smell of coffee is inviting the person to start their day.
 
• The use of **"wafted through the air"** creates a sensory image of the aroma spreading around.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The smell of __**subsequently**__ brewed coffee wafted through the air, beckoning him to start his day.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (hitherto)** means until now or up to a particular time. (अभी तक)
 
• **Option 2 (quickly) **means at a fast pace or with speed. (जल्‍दी, शीघ्र; थोड़े समय में)
 
• **Option 3 (preserved) **means to maintain or keep something in its original state. (किसी वस्‍तु को सुरक्षित या अच्‍छी हालत में रखना)

47:Tb0d,

The correct answer is **"affects."**
